title: data for roles.escalate
description: CoS-only: record one failed gate for a task. The gate label is normalised to a short stable key (lower-case, attempt markers and parentheticals dropped, spaces to "-"), so two attempts of one gate add up; the event keeps the key and the raw text. At the second fail on the same key the code slot moves up one tier (deepseek, sonnet, opus), unless the owner set it. If the server has no CoS identity on the token, data.lane must spell "CoS".

lane.description: The calling lane when the token carries none: must be "CoS".
